name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery does not grant execution support. The legacy batch writer remains runtime-disabled. Dispatcher ded07x99dcxb504 is connected-read-admitted only on its reviewed tuple; future mismatches fail closed. Current readers cover calculations, project metadata, PCB layers, loaded identities and bounded geometry; these are not complete saved-design inventories. Writing remains limited to eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each write needs original ownership, current runtime admission, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. General schematic/PCB geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. A separate launch-sealed String precreate workflow now joins original PCB and project-worker source qualification with two fixed observation sweeps. It does not create geometry or Save, upgrade an old diagnostic owner, prove complete latent producers or establish writer eligibility. Dormant native create/Save, publication-capture and SQL/history components are packaged for further integration; they are not registered design actions. The next batch adds fixed private common-state and latent-producer runners, preserving raw backing values and reacquiring V8 scopes for each sample. These runners are not exposed by the current precreate tool and do not establish a complete baseline or queue completion. Installed185144 passed the initialization prefix but refused the post-open title check; original normal closure and release completed with the closed disposable unchanged. Source inspection corrects the UUID-only route to retain its base title rather than expecting a filename prefix. That correction and the combined observations still need connected qualification. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate, replay caches or automatically Save; they are not isolated. Ambiguous calls stay consumed. Inspection, normal closure, proved root/Job termination, helper release and durable settlement are separate steps. No Save/Discard choice, forced termination, blind retry, caller JavaScript or unrestricted Save is supported. Lost ownership cannot be reconstructed from journals. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The installed-catalog checker uses a separate synthetic profile, not the live owner. Consult the skills and exhaustive coverage inventory for each supported subset and remaining work.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
